quote.text: Love, unless it is for life as a whole, is contaminated by things such as our preferences and memories.
quote.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that the love you offer your children should be unconditional and encompass every phase of their growth, not limited by transient preferences or past recollections.
    • Strive for a holistic commitment to your child's development, embracing both their strengths and challenges, and nurturing them with an enduring love that transcends fleeting moods or memories.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, cultivate a love for your team that is rooted in a comprehensive understanding of their capabilities and potential, rather than being swayed by short-term biases or individual preferences.
    • Act with consistency and broad-mindedness by focusing on the overall flourishing of your team, ensuring that your support is continuous and motivated by long-term visions instead of momentary impulses.
  • Product Management
    • In managing products, commit to the big picture of your product’s journey, ensuring that decisions are guided by a holistic vision rather than being marred by selective memories or current trends.
    • Foster a product strategy that reflects enduring value and long-term customer relationships, acknowledging that genuine attachment to a product must cover its complete life cycle rather than sporadic, preference-driven insights.
